words.sense: Lessen distress, fear, worry, or physical discomfort.
misconceptions: Confused with appease when the defining clue is overlooked.

words.sense: Calm someone angry by giving in to a demand.
misconceptions: Confused with assuage when the defining clue is overlooked.

semantic_axes.description: Assuage reduces distress; appease settles someone’s anger by conceding something.

edges.boundary_rule: Assuage reduces distress; appease settles someone’s anger by conceding something.
clues_a: Lessen distress, fear, worry, or physical discomfort.
clues_b: Satisfies an angry party through concession.
Calm someone angry by giving in to a demand.
irrelevant_clues: format, colour, or popularity unless they establish the boundary
location or timing that does not change the decisive feature

misconceptions.M1: Treating assuage as though it always means appease.
misconceptions.M2: Treating appease as though it always means assuage.
misconceptions.M3: Overvaluing a distracting detail instead of the decisive semantic distinction.

chains.frame: Which word best describes what Amina’s message did for her worried friend?

beats.text: Amina texted her friend that the lost train ticket had been found, and his hands stopped shaking.
beats.decisive_clue: his fear eased when he learned the ticket was safe
beats.reason: This establishes that his fear eased when he learned the ticket was safe.

beats.text: The message included a photograph of the ticket with his name visible.
beats.decisive_clue: his fear eased when he learned the ticket was safe
beats.reason: The photo reinforces reassurance; nobody has been given a concession to stop angry demands.

chains.feedback_short: His fear eased when he learned the ticket was safe; that detail favors assuage.
chains.feedback_deep: The photo reinforces reassurance; nobody has been given a concession to stop angry demands. Assuage reduces distress; appease settles someone’s anger by conceding something.
chains.contrast_rule: Assuage eases distress; appease gives ground to anger.

hints.attention: Notice what feeling the message changes.
hints.axis: Assuage reduces distress; appease settles someone’s anger by conceding something.
hints.contrast: Assuage eases distress; appease gives ground to anger.
